sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            xs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; ys=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)))
    return sorted(out)
print("before:", eyes(last_transition.before_frame))
print("after:", eyes(last_transition.after_frame))
r = action(['RIGHT'])
print(r['board_changed'])
print("after RIGHT:", eyes(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
